moves.name: Elemental Release / Discharge: full blast
moves.desc: Big explosion that ends the elemental release thrust (full charge); shared by the sword and lightsword release. (MV 270)
moves.input: finish the elemental release (hold, then release)

use.how: finish the elemental release (hold, then release) from neutral (action 177), or after Elemental Release, charge ticks (k106:12): Vertical button (guide k346); after Elemental Release, charge ticks (variant) (k106:62): Continuous Slash button in lightsword mode (guide k347 剣：連続斬り)

moves.name: Elemental Release / Discharge: early blast
moves.desc: Small explosion when the release is cancelled early (weak finish). (MV 160)
moves.input: tap the other button after the release thrust

use.how: after Elemental Release, charge ticks (k106:12): release button right after the thrust; after Elemental Release, charge ticks (variant) (k106:62): tap the other button after the release thrust

moves.name: Absolute Release: blast (3 ticks)
moves.desc: Explosion after the finisher when all three absorb ticks hit (the biggest, MV 375). (MV 375)
moves.input: release after three ticks

use.how: later hit of Absolute Release finisher (3 ticks), hit 1 (k106:26), in the same action 86,177: no input of its own

moves.name: Absolute Release: blast (1-2 ticks)
moves.desc: Explosion after the finisher when one or two absorb ticks hit. (MV 280)
moves.input: release after one or two ticks

use.how: later hit of Absolute Release finisher (1-2 ticks), hit 1 (k106:28), in the same action 85: no input of its own

moves.name: Absolute Release: early blast
moves.desc: Small explosion when no absorb tick landed. (MV 125)
moves.input: release right after the thrust
